name: prio
description: Stacked PR manager — merge-up approach, apply multiple branches at once to your work tree, remember merge conflict resolutions for later.

scripts.build:binary: npm run tauri build -- --no-bundle && node scripts/copy-cli-binary.js
scripts.postpublish: git add . && node -e "require('child_process').execSync(`git commit -m v${require('./package.json').version}`, { stdio: 'inherit' })" && git push
